import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import solver, controller, probability

saved = {}
orig_spfa = solver.MCF.spfa_pi
cnt = [0]
def spfa(self, pi):
    cnt[0] += 1
    if cnt[0] == 3:
        saved['mcf'] = self
    return orig_spfa(self, pi)
solver.MCF.spfa_pi = spfa

req = json.load(open('tmp/case_2.json'))
c = req['cases'][0]
preds = controller._predict(c['model'], c['windows'])
thr = [int(t) for t in probability.window_thresholds(c['stats'], c['windows'])]
res = controller._plan(c, preds, thr)

mcf = saved['mcf']
from ncycle import build
K, arcs, x = build(req, {'results': [dict(res, reports=None)]})
print('K', K, 'mcf.n', mcf.n)
# rebuilt residual edges
rebuilt = set()
for (u, v, l, h, cc), xf in zip(arcs, x):
    if xf < h: rebuilt.add((u, v, cc))
    if xf > l: rebuilt.add((v, u, -cc))
live = set()
for u in range(mcf.n):
    for ei in mcf.adj[u]:
        if mcf.cap[ei] > 0:
            live.add((u, mcf.to[ei], mcf.cost[ei]))
print('live only:', sorted(live - rebuilt)[:10])
print('rebuilt only:', sorted(rebuilt - live)[:10])
